environment.description: Same Step Functions workflow behind API Gateway, but the API Gateway is configured as a PRIVATE endpoint accessible only through a VPC Interface Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint has a security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) with inbound rules allowing TCP/443 only from 10.200.0.0/16 and 172.16.48.0/20 (internal partner network ranges allocated via IPAM). The API Gateway resource policy explicitly denies all requests NOT originating from the specified VPC endpoint. Additionally, the NLB fronting the VPC endpoint has a listener-level target group health check that introduces variable latency (50-200ms jitter) on responses, and the VPC flow logs feed into a GuardDuty anomaly detector with a custom threat intel list. The security group has no 0.0.0.0/0 rules and the VPC has no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached to the subnet hosting the endpoint ENIs.
